pregame.pressurePoint: Arkansas run game vs Texas A&M run defense. Texas A&M is No. 43 of 138 against the run (37%). Arkansas ranks No. 116 in rush success rate (39%). Under 3 and the game plan has to change.

Deep balls are the lowest-percentage play in this game. Texas A&M needs the underneath game and yards after catch.
